settings.title: Home Widget Boards
settings.description: Choose which boards' posts appear in the home page recent and popular posts widgets.
settings.notice: This only controls visibility and does not change read permissions. The notice ticker is not affected.
settings.help: Drag a card between the two areas, or use the X / + button on the card. New boards are included automatically.
settings.filter_placeholder: Filter by board name or slug
settings.included_hint: Boards whose posts appear in the widgets
settings.excluded_hint: Boards whose posts are hidden from the widgets
settings.empty_excluded: Drop a card here to hide that board from the widgets.

home.title: Home Page Settings
home.description: Turn the five home sections on or off, choose one or two columns and pick the widget for each column.

preview.title: Section layout
preview.help: Sections sit on the home page from the top in order 1 to 5. Hover over a row on the right or click it to highlight that section's box. Changes to On and Columns show in the boxes right away, before saving; sections that are off are dimmed.

section_desc.s1: Section 1 is the top section of the home page. Choose the widget for each column. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
section_desc.s2: Section 2 sits below section 1. Choose the widget for each column. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
section_desc.s3: Section 3 sits below section 2. Choose the widget for each column. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
section_desc.s4: Section 4 sits below section 3. Choose the widget for each column. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.
section_desc.s5: Section 5 is the bottom section of the home page. Choose the widget for each column. With 2 columns the left and right columns sit side by side (1:1) and stack on narrow screens.

col.board_pick_help: Drag cards between the two areas or use the X / + buttons. Only boards in 'Not included' are left out; new boards are included automatically. This only controls visibility, not read permission.
col.section_off: This section is off. Turn it on in the Widget Layout tab.
col.limit_popular_hint: Popular posts are picked from the site-wide popular cache, so fewer items than set may appear.
col.title: Title
col.icon_help: The first cell is the default icon for the widget type. Hover over an icon to see its name.
col.select_all_help: Move every board to 'Included'. With a search term, only the matching boards move.
col.select_none_help: Move every board to 'Not included'. With a search term, only the matching boards move.
col.html_help: HTML only. Scripts, event attributes (onclick, ...) and javascript: links are removed both when saving and when showing.
col.webzine_unavailable: The webzine style is available when g7-webzine-addon is installed.
col.webzine_unavailable_help: While the add-on is missing or turned off, columns already saved as webzine show recent posts on the home page instead, and switch back once the add-on is on again.
